Welcome to <tenant_id>, <username> 👋
Let's get your security workspace up and running — personalized to how you work.

This won't take long. We'll help you connect tools, configure alerts, and automate your daily tasks.

🧠 Let's power up your AI Teammate

Now that the core skills are in place, let's enable communication 
so your AI Teammate can interact with you — just like a real team member.

It will share updates, surface alerts, and respond to your commands in real time.

Connect your communication workspace
Choose Slack, Microsoft Teams, Skype, or your preferred tool.
This allows me to:
-Send alerts directly to channels or individuals
-Notify you of escalations or blockers
-Answer your questions in real time
🛡️ All messages are secure, and permissions are limited to the channels you approve.

Now Let's Build Your Knowledge Repository
🔐 I'll only use this gateway for automated communication you approve.
Here's what you can add:
– Security & Compliance Policies (AUP, Access Control, etc.)
– Incident Response Playbooks
– GRC Documentation (SOC 2, ISO, NIST frameworks)
– Internal SOPs or knowledge base articles
– Threat intel feeds or watchlists
– Any guidelines you want me to follow while acting on your behalf

🧠 These help me act exactly the way your team expects — no guesswork.

🔗 Use the attachment option below to attach documents.
🔐 I'll only use this gateway for automated communication you approve.

📁 Documents Uploaded Successfully!
Upload
✅ Your files are now securely stored in your Knowledge Repository. 
🧠 I'll scan, tag, and learn from them — so I can take actions, respond to incidents, and 
generate reports based on your organization's actual policies and procedures.

📌 You can add or update documents anytime from your Repository settings.

🚀 You're all set! Your AI Teammate is now ready to start assisting you.

🧠 Set Your AI Teammate's Behavior
You can guide how I behave by telling me how you'd like me to communicate, prioritize, or handle different situations.
Upload
For example, you might say:
– "Be formal when writing reports"
– "Flag critical risks to me immediately and explain why"
– "Escalate only when an SLA is at risk"

💬 Don't worry about being too precise — just talk to me like you would with a new teammate!

✍️ Write any preferences below — 
or feel free to skip for now. You can always configure this later from the AI Teammate Settings.

🎉 Your AI Teammate is Ready!
You've completed the personalization — your AI Teammate now understands how to communicate, 
prioritize, and act like a true member of your team.
